## Change

Release pull request opened by release-please. Merging it releases the version named below. release-please wrote the version bumps in `.release-please-manifest.json`, `pyproject.toml`, `version.txt` and `README.md`, and the changelog entry below, from the Conventional Commit subjects since the last release.

## Validation

release-please runs no check. CI on this pull request runs the release gates (milestone check, release end-to-end evidence) and the required status checks of the `main` ruleset, which block the merge until they pass.
